violations.text: -The hand-washing sink in the dish room was blocked by wooden boxes and miscellaneous items. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. -Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in near the ice machine. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

Molluscan Shellfish tags did not have all of the required information. The date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026

Food contact surfaces of the slicer were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
Lids to food processors were observed cracked in several areas. Equipment to be in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026
Men's urinal in staff restroom was observed draining slowly. System to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026
Molluscan shellfish tags must have date when the last shellfish was used from the bag. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/06/2025
